full_prompt_en: A square colored-crayon drawing on warm cream paper shows a young woman resting with her eyes closed. Her head tips gently toward the left and leans into one hand, which is partly covered by a dark green sleeve. Brown hair swept back from her forehead is threaded with blue, purple, and copper strokes. The face is modeled softly through layers of peach, ocher, rose, lavender, and pale blue hatching, with a bright area across the forehead and cheek. Her closed eyelids and relaxed lips are precisely placed but not outlined with a hard contour. A multicolored scarf or draped fabric in teal, violet, green, and crimson curls around the lower right side of the head. Behind her, dense navy, burgundy, and dark brown crayon strokes form an irregular shadow field. The outer edges of the drawing stop before the paper border in places, showing ragged marks and unfilled cream ground. Several colored pencils lie beside the sheet along the right edge and a few are partly visible to the left, confirming the physical drawing setup. The paper is slightly angled rather than perfectly squared to the frame. Light falls evenly from above, revealing waxy pigment buildup, parallel strokes, paper grain, and tiny lighter gaps between marks. The composition is intimate and quiet, with the face larger than life in the cropped sheet. No lettering, frame, or graphic overlay appears. The drawing balances careful observation with visibly handmade color layering, letting the tender sleeping expression emerge from thousands of small directional marks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色蜡笔画绘在暖奶油色纸上，画中年轻女子闭眼休息。她的头轻轻向左倾，靠在一只手上，手的一部分藏在深绿袖中。棕发从额前向后梳，夹着蓝、紫与铜色线痕。面部由桃色、赭黄、玫瑰色、薰衣草色和淡蓝色排线柔和塑形，额头与脸颊有亮区。闭合眼睑与放松嘴唇位置准确，却没有硬边轮廓。青绿、紫、绿和绯红的多色围巾或披布卷在头部右下。身后密集深海蓝、勃艮第红和深棕蜡笔笔触形成不规则影场。画面外缘在部分位置停于纸边之前，露出参差痕迹和未填满的奶油色底纸。几支彩铅沿纸右缘放着，左侧也露出少量笔，确认实体绘画场景。纸张略斜，并非严格与方框齐平。上方均匀光显出蜡质色素堆积、平行线痕、纸纹和笔迹间细小浅缝。构图亲近安静，脸在裁切纸面里大过真实比例。没有文字、相框或图形叠层。画在细致观察与可见手工色层之间平衡，使温柔的睡姿从数千道小定向笔迹中浮现。
style_prompt_en: Use layered colored-crayon drawing on visible cream paper. Build rounded volume from countless short directional strokes and crosshatched strands rather than smooth blending, letting warm peach, ocher, rose, and copper meet cool teal, violet, and blue. Give shadow areas dense overlapping pigment and focal highlights lighter paper gaps. Keep edges slightly ragged, with unfinished marks and a margin of exposed ground. Allow waxy buildup, paper tooth, and the pressure of individual strokes to remain visible. Lighting should be even enough to reveal the physical material. The overall impression is intimate and handmade, combining careful tonal observation with vibrant, textured color transitions.
style_prompt_zh: 在可见奶油色纸上使用层叠彩色蜡笔绘画。以无数短促定向线和交叉排线塑造圆润体积，而非平滑混色，让暖桃、赭、玫瑰与铜色交会冷青绿、紫及蓝。阴影区密集叠色，焦点高光处多留浅纸缝。边缘略参差，保留未完成痕迹和露出的底纸边。蜡质堆积、纸齿与单道笔压都应可见。光线足够均匀，以揭示实体材料。整体亲近且有手作感，把细致明暗观察与鲜活、带肌理的色彩过渡结合。
theme_en: A sleeping young woman rendered in layered colored crayon on paper
theme_zh: 用多层彩色蜡笔绘在纸上的沉睡年轻女子
name: Crayon drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
